description: MFA + step-up + break-glass + audit explorer + escape coverage + docs/smoke. Implements real TOTP enrollment/verification with bcrypt recovery codes, the mandatory-MFA gate for platform accounts, a stateless action-class-bound step-up token wired on SupportGrant creation, the SupportGrant lifecycle + break-glass read proxy (the ONLY caller of withSupportGrant), the platform/tenant grant endpoints and audit explorer scopes, the extended escape suite + generalized meta-test policy map, and the .env.example role-contract doc. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema + withSupportGrant) and FEAT-002 (recordAuditEvent, audit_events reads). Maps to impl-plan.md steps 7-10.
steps: Step 7a: Create apps/api/src/services/mfa.ts: set authenticator.options = { window: 1, step: 30 }; generateSecret + otpauth URI (qrcode data URL) + verify; RECOVERY_CODE_COUNT = 10 Crockford base32 codes (^[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10}$, displayed XXXXX-XXXXX, stored bcrypt-hashed, consumed hash removed on use); step-up token mint/verify (signed JWT { userId, jti, stepUp:true, action, exp: 5m } via the existing @fastify/jwt signer). All reads/writes on privilegedPrisma.

Step 7b: Create apps/api/src/routes/mfa.ts under /api/auth/mfa (preHandler [authenticate]): POST /enroll/start (generate secret, store on User.mfaSecret WITHOUT enabling, return otpauth URI + qrcode data URL), POST /enroll/verify { code } (on success set mfaEnabled + mfaEnrolledAt, issue 10 recovery codes returned plaintext once, store bcrypt hashes; audit platform.mfa.enrolled SUCCESS; on failure audit DENIED + 400), POST /verify { code } (TOTP or recovery code; mints the step-up token). Register mfaRoutes in the server.

Step 7c: Create apps/api/src/middleware/step-up.ts: requirePlatformMfa() (403 { error: 'MFA enrollment required' } when a platform.* holder lacks mfaEnabled, exempting the MFA enrollment endpoints; check via privilegedPrisma.user.findUnique) and requireStepUp(actionClass) (verify x-step-up JWT: signature, expiry, userId === request.auth.userId, stepUp===true, action===actionClass; else 401 { error: 'Step-up required' }). Mark the other high-risk actions with a // PHASE-0 SEAM comment. Wire requirePlatformMfa() into the platformRoutes plugin after the existing requireSuperAdmin() hook.

Step 7d: Unit tests apps/api/src/services/__tests__/mfa.test.ts per design 9.1: TOTP enroll->verify happy path at { window:1, step:30 }; wrong code rejected; exactly 10 recovery codes each matching the regex; recovery code single-use; step-up mint/verify incl. wrong action-class; guard 403/401 shapes.

Step 8a: Create apps/api/src/services/support-grant.ts: zod createSupportGrantSchema { institutionId, purpose (1..500), expiresAt (> now, <= now+MAX_TTL, MAX_TTL=4h named const), scope? }; create ACTIVE + activatedAt + grantedToUserId=request.auth.userId; lazy auto-expire via conditional updateMany WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND expiresAt<=now() with recordAuditEvent('platform.support_grant.expired') ONLY when count===1; the ONLY caller of withSupportGrant — a break-glass read proxy that validates the grant on privilegedPrisma first (ACTIVE, not expired, grantedToUserId===caller, institution not suspended), reads inside withSupportGrant with explicit where:{ institutionId: grant.institutionId }, then writes platform.support_grant.accessed on a SEPARATE privilegedPrisma recordAuditEvent AFTER withSupportGrant returns (awaited; failure -> 500, discard result).

Step 8b: Add platform endpoints in routes/platform.ts: POST /api/platform/support-grants (preHandler [requirePermission('platform.support.grant'), requireStepUp('support_grant.create')]; audit created + activated), DELETE /api/platform/support-grants/:id (revoke; requirePermission('platform.support.grant'); no step-up), GET /api/platform/support-grants?institutionId=&status= (list + opportunistic expiry), the break-glass read proxy GET /api/platform/support-grants/:id/tenant/... (one proxy: granted tenant audit_events + passes list), and GET /api/platform/audit-events?scope=platform|grant&grantId= (scope=platform -> where institutionId:null; scope=grant -> validate ACTIVE grant, filter institutionId:grant.institutionId).

Step 8c: Add tenant endpoints in routes/admin.ts: POST /api/admin/support-grants/:id/revoke (preHandler [requirePermission('admin.support.revoke')]; load on privilegedPrisma, assert grant.institutionId === request.auth.institutionId else 404; set REVOKED/revokedAt/revokedByUserId/revokedReason; audit platform.support_grant.revoked) and GET /api/admin/support-grants (preHandler [requirePermission('campus_movement.audit.view')]; read via withTenant -> support_grants_tenant_read). Apply the error-handling table from design 8.
Step 8d: Unit tests apps/api/src/services/__tests__/support-grant.test.ts: lazy-expiry flips ACTIVE->EXPIRED when expiresAt passed; revoke transitions; operator-binding check.

Step 9a: In apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts add audit_events and support_grants to RLS_TABLES; add a per-table expected-policy map (audit_events -> {tenant_isolation_select, audit_events_tenant_insert}; support_grants -> {support_grants_tenant_read}; everything else -> {tenant_isolation_select, tenant_isolation_modify}); extend teardown to delete new-table rows child-first.
Step 9b: Update apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts meta-test #6 to use the per-table policy map.

Step 9c: Add apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/superadmin-security.integration.test.ts covering design 9.2: (1) break-glass scope through the real withSupportGrant (A rows only, zero B, incl. a filter-less probe; SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY pooler-compat; a write inside the helper REJECTED with 'cannot execute ... in a read-only transaction'; .accessed audit written with the right supportGrantId); (3) the THREE GUC states (unset / empty-string / foreign) asserted on BOTH the audit_events SELECT policy and the INSERT WITH CHECK (zero rows on SELECT, rejection on INSERT unless a valid matching non-empty GUC); (4) append-only: campass_app UPDATE/DELETE on audit_events rejected by GRANT, AND the trigger rejects UPDATE and DELETE on the privileged owner connection, while a privileged support_grants UPDATE (lazy-expiry) still succeeds; (5) tenant transparency (A sees only A's grants, B's invisible); (6) grant lazy-expiry idempotency (two concurrent loads -> exactly one platform.support_grant.expired row).

Step 10a: Update apps/api/.env.example to document the role contract (design 10): DATABASE_URL MUST be campass_app (NOBYPASSRLS, 6543) used by both the tenant client and breakGlassPrisma; PRIVILEGED_DATABASE_URL / DIRECT_URL MUST be postgres (BYPASSRLS); warn that mispointing DATABASE_URL defeats RLS + break-glass (the startup probe fails closed). Add NO new secret.

Step 10b: Final gate + live smoke: root npm run build; cd apps/api && npx vitest run (all green against live Supabase); build then node apps/api/dist/server.js and confirm startup + a platform MFA gate + a grant create/access/accessed audit round-trip. Remove any temp scripts; never stage .env.
acceptance_criteria: A platform account without mfaEnabled is 403'd on every platform route except the MFA enrollment endpoints; enrollment issues exactly 10 single-use recovery codes.
Creating a SupportGrant requires platform.support.grant AND a fresh step-up token bound to action class support_grant.create (401 without / with wrong class); create and activate audits are written.

Break-glass reads through withSupportGrant return only the granted tenant's rows (zero other-tenant rows even with the filter removed), are read-only by construction (a write is rejected by Postgres), and each access writes one platform.support_grant.accessed audit row; a tenant admin sees that row in GET /api/admin/audit-logs.

A tenant admin can revoke a grant into their own institution via admin.support.revoke (404 for a grant into another tenant) and can read their own grants via GET /api/admin/support-grants (RLS-scoped).
The escape meta-test passes with the per-table policy map; the three-GUC-state + append-only + transparency + lazy-expiry-idempotency integration cases pass against live Supabase.
cd apps/api && npx vitest run passes ALL tests (142 baseline + new); root npm run build passes; node dist/server.js starts and serves a smoke request; no .env is staged.
verification: cd apps/api && npx vitest run   (all tests green against live Supabase)
cd apps/api && npm run build && node dist/server.js   (live smoke: startup + grant create/access/accessed round-trip, then stop)
